security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: A privacy screen for your desktop.
bundle.longDescription: Shade dims everything on your screens except what you're working on: a spotlight around your mouse, the window you're using, or a reading band. One shortcut drops a curtain over everything. Free and open source, on Windows, macOS and Linux.
